hero_sub: Moving to the island but not here yet? Our team views, vets and shortlists rental properties on your behalf — so your first day on Koh Samui starts with keys, not a hotel room and a browser tab.
problem_lead: Photos flatter. Listings go stale. Landlords disappear. Without someone on the ground, you're relying on strangers and guesswork for one of the biggest decisions of your move.

pricing.name: Scout
pricing.description: A curated shortlist, fully researched — ideal if you can view in person yourself once you land.

pricing.name: Shortlist
pricing.description: We do the legwork so your shortlist is already vetted, filmed and ready to compare.

pricing.name: Full Relocation
pricing.description: End-to-end support from search to signed lease and move-in day.

pricing_note: Fees cover our time and local expertise, not the properties themselves — you deal directly with landlords for rent and deposits. Prices shown in Thai Baht; happy to quote in your home currency on request.
request_lead: Share your brief and preferred package below. We'll confirm the fee and get searching as soon as it's settled.
